auth.subtitle: Private club.
auth.modes: Sign in or become a member

auth.invalid_credentials: That name and password don't open this door.
auth.required: You need to sign in first.
auth.invalid_token: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.too_many_requests: Too many tries. The doorman asks you to wait a minute.
auth.registered_sign_in: You're a member now. Sign in with your name and password.

user.username_taken: Another member already goes by that name.
user.email_taken: That email is already in the members' book.
user.already_exists: That name or email is already taken.

validation.email: That doesn't look like an email.
validation.max_utf8_bytes: Too long (accents and emoji count double).

request.rejected: The request didn't get through. Try again.

internal.error: Something broke in the back room. Try again in a while.

data.conflict: That clashes with what's already on the books. Try again.

wallet.not_found: We can't find your wallet. Let the house know.
wallet.insufficient_funds: That costs more Shrutebucks than you're carrying.
wallet.conflict: Your wallet was busy. Try again.
wallet.idempotency_mismatch: That operation already went through with different details.

bar.credit_not_needed: You can still afford a drink. The invitation is for anyone who's broke.
bar.credit_used_today: The house already treated you today. More tomorrow.
bar.too_many_requests: You're going too fast. Give me a minute.

talk.label: Conversation with the barman
talk.thinking: The barman is thinking it over…
talk.resting: The barman is taking a breather. Use the questions or the menu.
talk.privacy: What you type is sent to Anthropic (USA), which processes it on our behalf to reply and deletes it under its own policy. We don't store it: it's only kept for a few minutes to follow the chat. Don't share personal data. More in {link}.

scene.glass: A drink served on the bar

greeting.nadie: Evening. What can I get you?
greeting.socio: Come in, I saved your seat.

serve.confianza: There you go, nice and cold.
serve.socio: For you, from the good bottle.

promotion.habitual: Here you go. You're a customer of the house now.
promotion.confianza: I know you now. From today, a regular.
promotion.socio: A member of the house. That calls for a toast.

broke.nadie: Out of chips? Tonight it's on the house.
broke.habitual: Out of chips? Relax, tonight's on me.
broke.confianza: Broke? For you, it's on me.
broke.socio: A member, broke? I'll sort that out.

barman.no_credit: I already treated you today. More tomorrow.
barman.busy: I'm swamped right now. Pick something from the menu or one of the questions.

ask.recommend: First time? Try a Bee's Knees. Smooth, with honey.
ask.rank: The more you order, the better I know you. Right now you're a {rank}.
